payload.title: Server-side re-projection and snapshots, so laptops never write site buckets
payload.description: ops content project, home-page snapshot, knowledge snapshot/archive and proposals publish write S3, CloudFront and KVS or invoke Lambda with the operator's AWS credentials, even with --auth user. Add narrow mutations (reprojectSite and similar) so only the server role holds those writes. Also closes the 10-31 home-page snapshot incident class.
